themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, often framing these as essential for national sovereignty and economic stability. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, Poland, Argentina, and France, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Prawo i Sprawiedliwość, La Libertad Avanza, and Rassemblement National are advocating for stricter immigration controls, economic protectionism, and cultural preservation.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands national priority in housing, agriculture, and economic policies to counter foreign competition and immigration.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for national sovereignty in economic and defense policies, emphasizing Italy's role in NATO and EU.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Pushes for policies prioritizing Polish citizens in housing, healthcare, and economic reforms, often clashing with EU directives.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Promotes economic nationalism, deregulation, and opposition to foreign influence in Argentina's economy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes air conditioning subsidies and climate policies framed as national priorities over EU mandates.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with both leaders engaging in public disputes over NATO commitments, military base usage, and personal insults. This theme reflects broader tensions between nationalist leaders and traditional alliances, with implications for transatlantic relations and European defense policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Criticizes Meloni for refusing to allow U.S. military bases in Italy to be used for operations against Iran, escalating public feuds.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Defends Italy's sovereignty and NATO commitments amid Trump's accusations, emphasizing diplomatic independence.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen publicly supports Meloni, criticizing Trump's remarks as 'very insulting' and defending European nationalist leaders.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Aligns with Meloni's stance, criticizing U.S. pressure on European allies and advocating for stronger EU defense autonomy.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, ranging from leadership disputes to ideological fractures. These conflicts are evident in Germany's AfD, Italy's Lega, Argentina's La Libertad Avanza, Sweden's Sverigedemokraterna, and the UK's Reform UK, where power struggles and policy disagreements threaten party cohesion.

themes.title: Judicial and corruption scandals in far-right governments
themes.blurb: Corruption scandals and judicial investigations are plaguing far-right governments and parties, with allegations ranging from financial misconduct to abuse of power. This theme is prominent in Argentina, Spain, Poland, Hungary, and the U.S., where leaders and officials face legal challenges that threaten their political legitimacy.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Manuel Adorni faces allegations of illicit enrichment and financial misconduct, with opposition parties pushing for his removal.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Accused of diverting public funds to party-affiliated foundations and facing corruption allegations in local governments.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Allegations of corruption in Warsaw hospitals and misuse of public funds, with calls for independent investigations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Government officials face corruption probes, including misuse of EU funds and embezzlement allegations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration officials face investigations over voter ID policies, housing reforms, and financial misconduct.

themes.title: Far-right leaders celebrate Colombia's election
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders in Argentina, the U.S., Spain, and France are celebrating the election of Colombia's far-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella. This theme reflects a broader trend of transnational solidarity among nationalist leaders, who see Colombia's shift as a victory for conservative and anti-leftist movements globally.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
